articles.title: How to create a MurihSpace account
articles.excerpt: Sign up as a member, creator or vendor in a few simple steps.

sections.heading: Choose your account type
sections.body: During sign-up you can register as a Member, Creator or Vendor. Creators get storefronts and subscription tools, Vendors can sell products, and Members can join communities and buy. You can upgrade your role later from Settings.

sections.heading: Pick a unique username
sections.body: Your username is your public handle (@you). We check availability instantly while you type, so pick something short and memorable.

sections.heading: Verify your email
sections.body: After registering we send a 6-digit code to your inbox. Enter it on the verification screen to unlock the full app — including the AI assistant. Didn't receive it? Tap "Send code" to resend.

articles.title: Verifying your email address
articles.excerpt: Email verification unlocks Mera and keeps your account secure.

sections.heading: Why verify?
sections.body: Verification confirms you own the email on your account and is required before you can use the AI assistant or receive important notifications.

sections.heading: Where to enter the code
sections.body: Go to the AI Assistant page (or follow the verification prompt after sign-up) and enter the 6-digit code we sent. The code expires after a short time — request a new one if it doesn't work.

sections.heading: Resend the code
sections.body: If the email doesn't arrive, check your spam folder. You can resend the code from the verification screen, or ask for help in the Help Center.

articles.title: Logging in and troubleshooting
articles.excerpt: Having trouble signing in? Here's what to check.

sections.heading: Standard login
sections.body: Use the email address or mobile number and password you registered with. Social logins with Google, Facebook or Apple also work if you linked them.

sections.heading: Forgotten password
sections.body: Use "Forgotten password?" on the login page. We'll email you a secure reset link. Choose a strong password you haven't used before.

sections.heading: Admins
sections.body: Administrators sign in through the dedicated admin portal at /securegate/login rather than the member login page.

articles.title: Editing your profile and identity
articles.excerpt: Set your photo, bio, cover and public details.

sections.heading: Profile photo and cover
sections.body: Upload a profile picture and cover image from Profile & Identity in Settings. Use a clear photo so people recognise you.

sections.heading: Bio and links
sections.body: Write a short bio and add your link-in-bio socials. The AI assistant can even draft a bio for you based on your niche.

sections.heading: Verification badge
sections.body: Creators can apply for a verified badge. It's reviewed by our team and helps your audience trust your account.

articles.title: Upgrading to a Creator or Vendor account
articles.excerpt: Unlock storefronts, subscriptions and more.

sections.heading: Where to upgrade
sections.body: Go to Settings → Upgrade Account. You can apply to become a Creator or Vendor depending on what you want to do.

sections.heading: What changes
sections.body: Creators can create a storefront, sell memberships, host live rooms and run brand deals. Vendors get product listings, inventory and fulfilment tools.

sections.heading: Review process
sections.body: Some upgrades are instant, others are reviewed by the team. Check your application status in Settings.

articles.title: Getting a verified badge
articles.excerpt: Earn the blue checkmark to build trust.

sections.heading: Apply
sections.body: Submit a verification request from your profile. You'll need to confirm your identity and provide links to your public presence.

sections.heading: Review
sections.body: Our team reviews each application. Approval is based on authenticity, notability and activity.

sections.heading: Renewal
sections.body: Badges are reviewed periodically. Keep your account active and your information up to date.

articles.title: Building your creator storefront
articles.excerpt: Set up a beautiful storefront and share it anywhere.

sections.heading: Create your storefront
sections.body: Creators get a public storefront where you can show your bio, products, posts and links. Choose from ready-made templates and switch anytime.

sections.heading: Add products and content
sections.body: Attach digital products, membership plans, events and social links. Every item appears as a tappable card on your page.

sections.heading: Share your link
sections.body: Your storefront gets a short link (murih.space/you) you can put in your bio on other platforms.

articles.title: Memberships and subscription plans
articles.excerpt: Charge a monthly fee for exclusive content and perks.

sections.heading: Create a plan
sections.body: In Subscriptions, build a monthly plan with a price, description and member perks like exclusive posts or early access.

sections.heading: Members get perks
sections.body: Subscribers unlock gated content you publish to your plan. You control exactly what each tier can see.

sections.heading: Getting paid
sections.body: Subscription earnings land in your Creator Wallet and can be transferred to your System Wallet or withdrawn once KYC is complete.

articles.title: Brand deals and collaborations
articles.excerpt: Find sponsors and manage proposals end to end.

sections.heading: Browse brand deals
sections.body: Creators can browse available brand campaigns and send proposals. Brands review and accept offers through the platform.

sections.heading: Invoicing
sections.body: Once a deal is accepted, raise a brand invoice. Payment is tracked and credited to your Creator Wallet.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.body: Complete agreed deliverables and mark milestones so both sides stay aligned.

articles.title: How to send a gift
articles.excerpt: Show love to your favourite creators with coins.

sections.heading: Pick a gift
sections.body: Choose a gift from the catalogue. Each gift has a coin price — the cost is debited from your System Wallet.

sections.heading: Pay from your System Wallet
sections.body: Gifts can only be sent from your System Wallet. If your balance is low, top it up or transfer earnings from your Creator or Business wallet first.

sections.heading: Go anonymous
sections.body: You can send a gift anonymously and choose a display name. The recipient will not see your identity.

articles.title: Receiving gifts and what you earn
articles.excerpt: Gifts you receive are credited to your Creator Wallet.

sections.heading: Where gifts go
sections.body: When someone sends you a gift, the net amount (after the platform receiving fee) is credited to your Creator Wallet as available balance.

sections.heading: Fees
sections.body: A small receiving fee applies to each gift. You can see the exact fee breakdown on the gift and in your wallet history.

sections.heading: Withdraw your earnings
sections.body: Transfer your Creator Wallet balance to your System Wallet to spend, or withdraw once your identity (KYC) is verified.

articles.title: Gift balance and top-up
articles.excerpt: Run out of coins? Here's how to top up.

sections.heading: Check your balance
sections.body: Your System Wallet shows your spendable balance. Gifts are priced in coins (minor units).

sections.heading: Top up
sections.body: Buy coins or deposit funds into your System Wallet from the wallet page. If you see an "Insufficient balance" error, top up or transfer funds first.

sections.heading: Transfer between wallets
sections.body: Move creator or business earnings into your System Wallet whenever you want to spend them on gifts, tips or purchases.

articles.title: Understanding your MurihPay wallets
articles.excerpt: System, Creator and Business wallets explained.

sections.heading: System Wallet
sections.body: Your everyday wallet for spending — buying coins, sending gifts and tips, and making purchases. Top it up to use it.

sections.heading: Creator Wallet
sections.body: Where you earn money from gifts, subscriptions and brand deals. Transfer earnings to your System Wallet to spend them.

sections.heading: Business Wallet
sections.body: Holds earnings from product sales and store activity. Business funds are managed separately and can also be transferred to your System Wallet.

articles.title: Depositing money into your wallet
articles.excerpt: Add funds securely via card or payment gateway.

sections.heading: How to deposit
sections.body: From the wallet page choose an amount and a payment method. You'll be taken through a secure checkout with our payment providers.

sections.heading: Currencies
sections.body: Your wallet uses a default currency. Deposits are converted and shown in minor units in your transaction history.

sections.heading: Idempotency
sections.body: Deposits are idempotent — retrying a request never charges you twice for the same order.

articles.title: Withdrawing and payouts
articles.excerpt: Move your earnings out of MurihSpace safely.

sections.heading: Before you withdraw
sections.body: You must complete KYC identity verification before requesting a payout. This is a security requirement.

sections.heading: Minimum amount
sections.body: Payouts have a minimum amount. If your balance is below it, keep earning or transfer to your System Wallet to spend instead.

sections.heading: Review process
sections.body: Payout requests are reviewed by the finance team and marked approved or rejected. Approved payouts are paid out to your provided details.

articles.title: Creating and managing a community
articles.excerpt: Start a space for your audience.

sections.heading: Create a community
sections.body: From the Communities page choose a name, category and privacy setting. Communities can be public or private.

sections.heading: Grow your members
sections.body: Share your community link and approve join requests. Members can post, comment and interact once they've joined.

sections.heading: Moderation
sections.body: Set posting rules, appoint moderators and pin important posts to keep your community healthy.

articles.title: Events and audio rooms
articles.excerpt: Host live audio rooms and events.

sections.heading: Schedule an event
sections.body: Create events from the Events page with a title, time and description. Attendees can RSVP.

sections.heading: Live audio rooms
sections.body: Host a live audio room from your community. Members join to listen and speak.

sections.heading: My Events
sections.body: Track events you've scheduled or RSVP'd to under "My Events".

articles.title: Selling digital products
articles.excerpt: Ebooks, courses, templates and more.

sections.heading: List a product
sections.body: Add a digital product with a title, description and price. Files are delivered automatically after purchase.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: Set your price in your preferred currency. You keep the sale price minus the platform fee.

sections.heading: Deliverables
sections.body: Buyers access purchases from their Purchase Library immediately.

articles.title: Selling physical products
articles.excerpt: Manage inventory, shipping and fulfilment.

sections.heading: Add a product
sections.body: Sellers can list physical products with images, variants and inventory levels.

sections.heading: Shipping profiles
sections.body: Configure shipping profiles per country or region so buyers see accurate delivery options.

sections.heading: Fulfilment
sections.body: Track orders, mark them shipped and handle returns and disputes from the store dashboard.

articles.title: Keeping your account secure
articles.excerpt: Passwords, 2FA and how we protect you.

sections.heading: Use a strong password
sections.body: Use a long, unique password you haven't used elsewhere. Change it regularly from Settings → Security.

sections.heading: Two-factor authentication
sections.body: Enable 2FA from the Security settings to add an extra layer of protection to your logins.

sections.heading: Unusual activity
sections.body: We monitor logins and can suspend accounts showing suspicious behaviour. Contact support if you believe your account was compromised.

articles.title: Managing your privacy
articles.excerpt: Control who sees what on MurihSpace.

sections.heading: Profile visibility
sections.body: Choose whether your profile and activity are public. Adjust these options under Settings → Privacy.

sections.heading: Communities
sections.body: Join public or private communities. Your posts inherit the community's visibility.

sections.heading: Your data
sections.body: See what data we hold and how it's used in the Privacy Policy. You can request deletion through support.

articles.title: KYC verification
articles.excerpt: Verify your identity to unlock payouts.

sections.heading: What is KYC?
sections.body: Know-Your-Customer verification confirms your identity so we can safely process payouts and prevent fraud.

sections.heading: How to complete it
sections.body: Go to KYC Verification in Settings, upload your documents and submit. Review usually takes a short time.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body: Payouts, some creator features and certain purchases are blocked until your identity is verified.
